```{r}
#| output: asis
source("../functions.R", local = knitr::knit_global())

projects <- c('P02','P03','P05','P06','P07','P08','P09','P10')

for (p in projects) {
  cat(str_c('### ',p,' \n'))
  load_publications() %>% 
    filter(project==p) %>% 
    print_publications(level=4)
}



```
